correctness.rationale: The omega-operator is computed exactly from the single indiscrete neighbourhood. D, 4 and 5 follow directly. Completeness is proved by reducing any serial-transitive-Euclidean countermodel to finitely many atom types over the common successor cluster and simulating those types by disjoint infinite blocks; a possible exceptional root point is finite and therefore irrelevant to infinitude/cofiniteness tests. The proof covers arbitrary modal depth by induction.

evidence: Montacute proves K4 completeness over the class of all infinite topological spaces, not over the single indiscrete space.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The class-level K4 theorem is neither stronger than nor a pointwise fixed-space classification. The new theorem determines the strictly stronger exact logic of one canonical non-T1 space.
